alert.explanation: Risk is elevated for malaria in Ilala in 8 weeks (week 2025-W08): about 2,708 cases, 2.08 per 1,000 people (95% interval 1,670-5,289). What is driving this: Inbound travel (measured 122,115) is pushing risk up, accounting for 15% of the signal — 8-week trailing mean of travellers from high-transmission areas import parasites. Inbound travel 3 weeks ago (measured 129,445) is pushing risk up, accounting for 12% of the signal — travellers from high-transmission areas import parasites. The combination of population density and inbound travel (measured 2.19) is pushing risk up, accounting for 6% of the signal — imported cases spread fastest in crowded districts.
